# SoftDesk — Full Content

> AI-powered desktop software management & smart launcher for macOS and Windows.
> Open source, free, cross-platform.
> This file contains the full content of all marketing pages for AI context.

Last Updated: 2026-08-06

## Product Overview

SoftDesk is a desktop application that helps you manage and launch software efficiently.
It scans installed applications, uses AI to automatically classify them, provides a radial
menu for quick launching via mouse middle-click, tracks usage time per app, and supports
one-click workflows to launch multiple apps together.

- Website: https://soft-desk-landing.pages.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/bayernjf/soft-desk
- Download: https://github.com/bayernjf/soft-desk/releases
- License: Open Source
- Platforms: macOS 11+ (Intel & Apple Silicon), Windows 10/11

---

## Feature: AI Smart Classification

Slug: ai-classification
Links: /en/features/ai-classification · /zh/features/ai-classification

Tagline: Let AI organize your software library automatically.

SoftDesk uses your configured AI models to automatically identify and categorize all installed
software. No manual sorting needed — AI assigns each app to the most appropriate category based
on its name, description, and purpose.

### How It Works

SoftDesk scans installed software, extracts name, version, publisher and other metadata, then
classifies them through your configured AI models (e.g., OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude). Results
are stored in a local SQLite database.

### Supported Categories

Development Tools, Design & Creative, Productivity, Communication, Browsers, System Utilities,
Media & Entertainment, Security. You can also customize the category system.

### Privacy Protection

AI classification requests are initiated locally, sending only software names and descriptions
to the AI provider for categorization. No personal data, file contents, or other sensitive
information is sent. Data is not stored by the AI provider after classification.

---

## Feature: Radial Menu Launcher

Slug: radial-menu
Links: /en/features/radial-menu · /zh/features/radial-menu

Tagline: Middle-click to launch instantly.

SoftDesk's radial menu is an innovative quick launcher. Press the middle mouse button anywhere
to summon a circular menu with your favorite apps at your fingertips. Supports paging,
drag-to-reorder, and smart recommendations.

### Usage

Press the middle mouse button (or a configured shortcut) anywhere in the system, and the radial
menu appears at the cursor position. Move the mouse to the corresponding sector to select an app,
then click to launch. Scroll to page through more apps.

### Customization

Drag apps into radial menu sectors to reorder. Each sector can hold one app or one folder
(containing multiple apps). Supports up to 8 sectors with unlimited pages.

### System Permissions

macOS requires Accessibility permission to monitor middle-click. Windows requires no additional
permissions.

---

## Feature: Usage Time Tracking

Slug: usage-tracking
Links: /en/features/usage-tracking · /zh/features/usage-tracking

Tagline: Know where your time goes.

SoftDesk precisely tracks usage time, launch count, and active periods for each application.
Visualize your usage patterns and discover productivity bottlenecks through charts.

### Tracking Dimensions

Total usage time, daily usage time, launch count, last used time, category-based statistics,
and daily/weekly/monthly trend analysis.

### Data Storage

All usage data is stored in a local SQLite database with no server uploads. You can clear
statistics or export data at any time.

### Visual Reports

The built-in dashboard provides bar charts, pie charts, line charts and more. View top app
rankings, category distribution, and trend changes.

---

## Feature: Cross-Platform Support

Slug: cross-platform
Links: /en/features/cross-platform · /zh/features/cross-platform

Tagline: macOS and Windows, consistent experience.

SoftDesk supports both macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Windows 10/11. Enjoy the same
interface design and feature set across platforms, with cloud sync to share configurations
between devices.

### System Requirements

macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later, supporting Intel and Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3). Windows 10 64-bit
or Windows 11.

### Software Scanning

macOS scans /Applications and ~/Applications directories. Windows scans the registry and common
install paths. Cross-platform software identity is aligned via bundleId.

### Cloud Sync

Optionally enable Supabase cloud sync to synchronize software library, favorites, workflows, and
configurations across multiple devices. Synced data is encrypted and contains no sensitive
information.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is SoftDesk?

SoftDesk is an AI-powered desktop software manager for macOS and Windows. It offers smart
classification, radial menu quick-launch, usage time tracking, and workflow automation to help
you manage desktop apps more efficiently.

### How does SoftDesk work?

SoftDesk scans installed software and uses AI to auto-classify them. You can summon a radial
menu via middle-click for quick launches, view usage statistics, and create workflows to start
multiple apps at once.

### Which platforms does SoftDesk support?

SoftDesk supports macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Windows 10/11.

### How does SoftDesk protect my privacy?

SoftDesk runs entirely locally. Software data is stored in a local SQLite database and no
personal data is uploaded. Cloud sync is optional and uses Supabase encrypted transport.

### Is SoftDesk free?

Yes, SoftDesk is open-source software and completely free to use. The source code is hosted on
GitHub under an open-source license.

---

## Technical Stack

- Desktop Framework: Electron 31 + React 18 + TypeScript
- Local Database: better-sqlite3
- Cloud Sync: Supabase (optional)
- AI Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other configurable providers
- Landing Page: Astro 7, Tailwind CSS v4, React 19 islands
- License: Open Source
